food.name: Plums
sourceNotes: USDA FoodData Central 169949, Plums, raw, per 100g.
Daily value percentages are derived from USDA nutrients using FDA adult DVs and rounded to the nearest whole percent.
Glycemic index is a context value derived from International GI Database raw/unspecified plum entries rather than USDA nutrient data.

topPros.title: simple whole-fruit snack
topPros.explanation: Easy to understand, easy to portion, and useful without much prep.

topPros.title: skin adds colour compounds
topPros.explanation: Eating the peel keeps the colourful plant-compound part of the fruit in the serving.

topPros.title: works in sweet meals
topPros.explanation: Plums can bring a fresh fruit role to yoghurt bowls, oats, salads, and desserts.

topCons.title: bruises easily
topCons.explanation: Soft fruit bruises quickly, so quality can drop fast after transport or storage.

topCons.title: ripeness window is short
topCons.explanation: The best eating window is narrow, and underripe or overripe plums are much less useful.

topCons.title: pit slows eating down
topCons.explanation: The stone makes them a little less convenient than fully edible bite-size fruit.

explanation.summary: Fats are carrying this food most, while minerals are holding it back most. It lands in D tier.
